subject: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aileen Murphy <aileen@fintechsy.com>, Tom Reed <aileen@fintechsy.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-20T15:10:00Z
Subject: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS

Thanks for the call earlier - great to meet the FintechSy team. Quick recap + two follow-ups so we can put together a hosted-API cost estimate and recommend unit economics that match your workload.

Recap (from our discovery):
- Use case: real-time fraud scoring + short contextual prompts for account support.
- Expected traffic shape: mix of short prompts (50-150 tokens) + model completions (200-800 tokens); occasional longer reports.
- Latency SLO: <300ms p95 for inference on key routes.

Clarifying questions to finalize pricing:
1) Expected monthly token volume (split if possible: prompt tokens vs completion tokens / embeddings).
2) Peak TPS (requests per second) during prime hours and expected sustained TPS.
3) Any strict compliance requirements that would push you to Private (VPC/on-prem) vs hosted API - e.g., data residency, encryption-at-rest/KMS, or SOC2 evidence requests.
4) Target budget or target $/1M tokens you want us to aim for in proposals.

If you can send the monthly estimate + peak TPS today or tomorrow, Ben and I will model cost scenarios (hosted pricing tiers, potential reserved commit for predictable unit economics) and return a short spreadsheet with:
- cost/$1M tokens at current load,
- expected monthly spend range,
- recommended approach (hosted vs dedicated/commit) and next steps.

Thanks - proposing a 30-min follow-up Wed or Thu to walk the numbers.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Subject: Re: Hosted API Pricing Qualification: expected monthly tokens + peak TPS

Thanks Marissa - quick answers below inline.

Monthly volumes (expected first 12 months):
- Average monthly total tokens: ~250,000,000 tokens/month (we estimate ~60M prompt tokens, ~190M completion tokens).
- Embeddings: negligible for now (~2-3M tokens).

Peak/sustained TPS:
- Peak TPS: ~60 TPS during peak windows (end-of-day batch scoring windows + real-time spikes).
- Sustained (typical daytime): ~20-25 TPS.

Budget/target $/1M tokens:
- We're targeting roughly $700-1,000 per 1M tokens for hosted API initially. If reserved commitments or dedicated capacity lowers that, we're open to discussing.

Compliance: SOC2 is important. We don't need on-prem for now but will need SOC2 evidence and a Data Processing Addendum.

Next steps: please send the cost scenarios you mentioned. We can do a follow-up Wed 05/21 10am PT.

Thanks,

Appreciate the quick details - very helpful. I've modeled a few hosted-API scenarios (attached: pricing-model.xlsx) and pulled a high-level unit-economics summary below. Ben, feel free to chime in if I missed anything.

High-level hosted API cost estimates (rough):
- Baseline assumptions: 250M tokens/month total; split prompts/completions per Tom's note.
- Example unit price tiers (hosted): $1,000 per 1M tokens -> $250k/mo; $800 per 1M tokens -> $200k/mo; $700 per 1M tokens -> $175k/mo.
- Peak TPS considerations: with 60 TPS peaks, our standard hosted pool handles the bursts but we recommend a buffer (burst capacity or short-term reserved capacity) to keep p95 latency <300ms.

Suggested next steps:
1) I'll schedule the Wed 10:00am PT follow-up to walk the spreadsheet and confirm SLOs (invite sent).
2) If you're targeting the $700-1,000 per 1M tokens band, we can show a path to reduce unit costs via a 6-12 month commit (Dedicated) or by optimizing batching/caching for your request shapes.
3) I'll attach a SOW-template and our SOC2 summary for procurement.

Ben - once you review the attachment, can you draft an initial recommended approach (hosted vs reserved commit) we can present on Wednesday?

Thanks - talk soon.

Best,
